verdicts.strongest_argument: This fails on size before it fails on publication. The April-June buying the finding relies on is 120,000 ADS at $10.57-$11.23 - about $1.3m against a $796m market cap, or 0.17%, and roughly five days of the 245,980-share average volume. That is the error the brief says hunters make most often: real, low-visibility, and far too small to matter. The five Form 4s themselves are in filings.json with acceptance times (0001034957-26-000055 on 08-26, 0001654954-26-007786 on 08-21, 0001654954-26-007576 on 08-13, and two on 07-30), so they were reachable, but no body is stored and therefore no share count, no price and no reporting person is established anywhere in this capture - the claim that they continue the same family programme is an assumption, not a reading. I have a specific doubt about their provenance that the capture cannot resolve and that would void the finding if correct: Cresud is a foreign private issuer, it files 20-F and 6-K, and foreign private issuers are exempt from Section 16 reporting under Rule 3a12-3(b), so Form 4s indexed on this CIK are more likely Cresud appearing as a reporting owner in another issuer's Section 16 filing - Cresud is the controlling holder of IRSA and has other listed affiliates - than Argentine executives reporting purchases of CRESY ADS. Nothing in the capture tells me which it is. The April-June detail is in any case published, in the stored body at the 2026-06-10T16:14:13Z entry. And the closing argument - 'if this were priced the stock would not be trading at the chairman's May purchase price' - is a run-up inference: the stock is up 9.63% over twenty days and 42.4% off its 52-week low, so the tape has hardly ignored the name.

verdicts.strongest_argument: The mechanism is structural and known, and the corpus publishes the parameters. That the fiscal-year-end release at this issuer carries the annual distribution is a fixed feature of Cresud's calendar, and the stored body already sets out the history and the expectation - ARS 93,782m plus IRSA shares last year at a stated ~8% yield, $1.056 per ADS in 2023, $0.9921 in 2024 and $0.50-1.00 anticipated this year (docs/967a6ce212eea3280a8162afd68eb43202019d07.txt, entries 2026-08-24T20:41:30Z, 2026-08-04T12:02:28Z, 2025-11-10T20:55:43Z, 2025-05-09T19:26:15Z). A known annual event with a published three-year history and a published expected range is not a hidden catalyst; it is a scheduled one, and 'everyone knows the distribution comes at the FY release' is the definition of age without novelty. The residual is genuine but narrow: the exact amount is unknown and is a function of ARS-denominated results, so there is real variance around a known event. That is worth something, which is why I am at 72 rather than 90. Two problems reduce it further. The argument that the issuer 'gets no US news coverage, no sell-side preview and no consensus in the whole capture' is an n_queries=0 artefact of a capture that ran no news search on this ticker, not a fact about coverage. And a dividend that transfers 4-8% of market cap out of the company is close to value-neutral to a holder on the ex-date, so the size the finding quotes is not the size of the price effect.

verdicts.strongest_argument: The finding says it itself: these are the company's own reported numbers, reproduced verbatim in the captured body from the Q1 FY26 and H1 FY26 releases (docs/967a6ce212eea3280a8162afd68eb43202019d07.txt, entries 2026-02-10T14:35:44Z and 2025-11-10T20:54:23Z). Company-disclosed prior-period results are the top of the priced-in scale, and there is no arithmetic here that the releases did not already perform - the -39.7% Q1 and -19.0% H1 adjusted EBITDA figures and the attribution of the net-income swing to the IRSA fair-value mark are the company's own words. The mechanism also does not reach this print as news: these are periods already reported and already reacted to, and the whole point of a fiscal-year-end release is that it supersedes them. What is actually being claimed is a narrative gap - that the corpus's other 76 items talk about record crops while operating earnings contract - and a divergence between retail chatter and a filing is not an unpriced fact, it is an observation about the composition of a Stocktwits dump. To the hunter's credit this finding is signed against its own two positive findings and labelled as the reason the net number is low, which is the right instinct.

prior_publication.what_it_says: Verbatim reproductions of the company's own Q1 FY26 and H1 FY26 releases carrying the EBITDA declines and the fair-value attribution.
